我是莫琰，也叫 MoMoZi。现在在某大模型公司做 Agent 技术产品，长期关注 Foundation Model × Agent × AI Product 的交叉地带。

我的起点是 AI 医学图像算法，后来走进百度研究院、百度飞桨、商汤与美团。从模型研究、开发者平台到大模型与 Agent，我一直在连接技术能力和真实需求。

北京理工大学 · 本科 & 硕士

生物医学工程 · 本科 2013–2017 / 硕士 2017–2020

研究方向：计算机视觉、3D 重建、图像分割与仿真建模。早期参与发表 SCI 论文 10+ 篇。

工作之外，我写 Skills、做多智能体决策和 Code Agent，也在「momo子讲AI」分享 AI 的观察与实践。

    Behind the scene

    Thank you for visiting my portfolio!
    If you are curious about the stack and how this adaptation was built, here’s everything you need to know.

    Three.js

    Three.js is the library I’m using to render this 3D world.
    It was created by mr.doob (X, GitHub), followed by hundreds of awesome developers, one of which being Sunag (X, GitHub) who added TSL, enabling the use of both WebGL and WebGPU, making this portfolio possible.

    Three.js Journey

    The original world author teaches Three.js in this huge course.
    It contains everything you need to start building awesome stuff with Three.js (and much more).

    Devlogs

    Bruno Simon documented the original portfolio’s development on his Youtube channel.

    Source code

    This world is adapted from Bruno Simon’s folio-2025. Original code is available on GitHub under MIT license. Original assets and game mechanics retain their MIT attribution. MoMoZi content comes from public GitHub repositories.
    This adaptation includes its own local world-state implementation and an optional self-hosted WebSocket server. It does not use the original private server.

    Musics

    The music you hear was made for the original Bruno Simon portfolio by the awesome Kounine (Linktree).
    They are now under CC0 license, meaning you can do whatever you want with them!
    Download them here.

    Some more links

    • Physics library ⇒ Rapier
    • Audio library ⇒ Howler.js
    • Fonts ⇒ Amatic SC & Nunito

    — 原作：Bruno Simon · MoMoZi 定制版
